phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C3 — BPS/BOP External Sector Structure Audit
purpose: Determine whether ECB BPS/BOP-IIP currency-and-deposits data provide an external-sector breakdown that can be mapped exactly to RMD H/C/F/G/BNR before any F21 recovery from BOP data.

source.dataset: ECB BPS — Balance of Payments and International Investment Position

promotion_rule: This phase may only classify BPS source structure. A later bridge may use BPS only if sector granularity, functional category, instrument definition, maturity, unit/currency, valuation and BPM6-versus-ESA reconciliation are explicitly satisfied.
negative_result_rule: If Romania publishes only coarse S1P/S12T sector groups for F2, the inability to separate H/C/non-MFI-F is a valid blocker and no synthetic split is permitted.
